audience: Shopify stores that sell subscriptions with Appstle

useCases.title: Check which subscriptions bill next week
useCases.text: List the subscription contracts with a next billing date in a window. Then read the upcoming orders of each contract.

useCases.title: Review one customer's subscriptions and orders
useCases.text: Search the customers who have subscriptions. Then read the subscriptions and the past orders of one customer.

useCases.title: Read the revenue and cycle metrics of a contract
useCases.text: Get the revenue and cycle metrics of one subscription contract. Then read the subscription groups and their plans.

useCases.title: Skip or unskip the next order of a subscription
useCases.text: Skip the next upcoming order of a subscription contract. Undo a skipped order with its billing attempt id.

useCases.title: Move a billing date or pause a subscription
useCases.text: Move the next billing date of a contract, change its delivery interval, or set the contract to ACTIVE or PAUSED.

useCases.title: Cancel a subscription for good
useCases.text: Cancel a subscription contract with an optional reason and note. Pending orders are cancelled too.
